steps.en: Failed SMS or email sends are recorded
steps.id: Pengiriman SMS atau email yang gagal dicatat

steps.en: Sending is retried on the same day
steps.id: Pengiriman diulang di hari yang sama
steps.why_en: The 2pm retry job exists but is switched off in every environment setting.
steps.why_id: Job retry jam 2 siang ada tapi dimatikan di semua pengaturan environment.

steps.en: Retries stop after a configurable number of attempts
steps.id: Percobaan ulang berhenti setelah jumlah yang bisa diatur
steps.why_en: Only one retry pass exists; the retry limit is never read or used.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada satu putaran retry; batas retry tidak pernah dibaca atau dipakai.

steps.en: Failed SMS messages are resent and the result saved
steps.id: SMS yang gagal dikirim ulang dan hasilnya disimpan

steps.en: Failed emails are resent and the result saved
steps.id: Email yang gagal dikirim ulang dan hasilnya disimpan
